notes:
Account snapshot: Cedarstrand is a regional healthcare provider (labs + outpatient clinics) evaluating a private VPC deployment for several production use-cases: patient triage chat, clinical decision support prompts, automated coding and summarization of visit notes. Primary driver = data residency & auditability. Security/IT are risk-averse; want private endpoints and strict egress control.

Key technical asks (from IT & Security):
- Private connectivity: prefer AWS PrivateLink endpoints into Redwood control plane but will consider VPC peering where PrivateLink not feasible. No public internet path for PHI traffic.
- Firewall rules / IP allowlist: IT requires exact egress IPs for approval; want a 2-week lead time for edge firewall updates.
- Egress controls: session-level egress policies, deny-by-default outbound rules, allow only specific S3 endpoints for model artifacts.
- KMS integration: want BYOK with HSM-backed keys; encryption-at-rest + in-transit; key rotation policy must align with our audit calendar.
- Audit logging: must forward all request-level logs and platform audit events to their Splunk instance (retention policy = 7 years for audit trails).
- Data residency: restricted to US-EAST region for PHI. Legal flagged this as blocker until SLA on residency is explicit.

Quotes / voice notes: "We can't have a path to the public internet for PHI — show us the flow and the control points." — Head of Security.

POC ask: small-scale private deployment (non-PHI sandbox) to validate latency and PrivateLink connectivity. Target perf SLOs: median generation latency for chat ~ <120ms at 95th percentile under 50 concurrent users; embeddings throughput target ~200 req/s during peak for search indexing jobs.

Commercial: procurement wants a committed Dedicated + Private bundle. Estimated ARR range provided above. Legal wants addendum covering data residency, KMS/BYOK, and audit log retention.

Operational notes: SE (Marco) to provide network diagram + exact IP CIDR blocks for PrivateLink endpoints. AE (Jia) to coordinate SOW and pricing. CSM (Elena) to be looped if POC succeeds.
